cases.name: Dalek Intensive Care
cases.text: When you planeswalk to Dalek Intensive Care and at the beginning of your upkeep, exile a non-Dalek creature you control. If you do, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace. It gains haste until end of turn.

When you planeswalk to Dalek Intensive Care and at the beginning of your upkeep, exile a non-Human creature you control. If you do, create a 3/3 black Dalek artifact creature token with menace. It gains haste until end of turn.
